post.description: Price-time matching on the canonical instrument. Futures buy limits must be at most 110% of the fresh reference index; sell limits must be at least 90%. Lower buys and higher sells are allowed, subject to ordinary risk/tick rules. Adverse limits reject without automatic repricing. At execution, resting orders breaching their own side limit are cancelled; a valid passive order beyond the incoming side limit stays open and stops matching. Market and reduce-only orders cannot buy above the cap or sell below the floor. Reduce-only derivative orders reserve no new initial margin or fee capacity. Closing fees debit available USDT first; any shortfall becomes a signed USDT settlement liability with matching fee-recipient claims. Position size/direction, fresh prices and execution limits still apply. A successful HTTP response is not a guarantee of a full fill: inspect status, remaining and cancelReason. Market remainders cancel; no fabricated liquidity. Self-trade prevention cancels the incoming remainder.

get.description: A consistent account snapshot. assets includes Funding and Unified Trading coin wallet balances, signed equity, mark-based P&L/option value, unsettled cash, transferable amounts and index-valued USD equity. risk distinguishes totalEquity from marginBalance, availableBalance and IMR/MMR percentages. Includes positions (including flat rows) with valuation, lifecycle and protection details, loans, supplies and DCA schedules; latest 100 risk events and liquidity requests. liquidityFees attributes actual BTC/USDT pool fee income using ownership at accrual, not current ownership. Fees remain compounded in NAV; this is cumulative reporting, not an unclaimed balance. Null amounts indicate unreconstructable history; since and completeHistory identify coverage. liquidityPerformance reports current share price/value, historical completed deposit and withdrawal USD totals, total P&L (current value + withdrawals - deposits), and nonannualized return on total deposits. Fees are included in NAV, not added again. Pending/cancelled requests are excluded. Missing historical values or unreconciled legacy shares make P&L unavailable. Funding balances are outside cross-margin equity.

get.description: Verified completed derivative lifecycles, ordered by closedAt descending then id descending. Partial exits accumulate until flat; reversal closes one row and starts another. All monetary values and counters are JSON strings. Actual opening/closing fees and signed funding are included. Owner and API-key product permissions apply before filters and pagination. Default 50 rows, maximum 100. Keep filters unchanged when following nextCursor; a cursor outside this account or filter returns 400. from/to are inclusive UTC closing dates. Older lifecycles with missing fees or untraceable funding/settlement are omitted rather than assigned estimated net P&L. New fills, funding and settlements update history atomically with accounting; delayed funding can update a closed row.

post.description: Perpetual, expiry futures and options. Entire-position, last-trade triggered OCO. Requires current lifecycleId/positionVersion and protectionVersion (0 for none). First triggered leg cancels sibling and starts durable reduce-only closing. Empty attempts update the same job without creating orders; retryDelayMs backs off from 100 ms to 1000 ms, resetting to 100 ms after a fill. Actual fills retain order and trade history. Attempts counts all checks, not just submitted orders. No hard attempt limit; serialization, reduce-only capacity and ordinary price checks apply. Closing-fee shortfalls accrue in signed USDT settlement rather than blocking the close. Same-direction additions are included; flat/reversal/expiry end the job. Cannot edit an active Closing job; stop it first. Both null remove protection. HMAC keys require the instrument product permission.

post.description: Atomically cancels/replaces the remaining quantity of an owned open/partially filled limit order. Uses opaque Order.version and matching instrument permission. Preserves prior fills; replacement has a new ID/priority and replacesId. Crossing price may execute immediately. Opening orders retain ordinary balance, margin and fee checks; reduce-only replacements use the same no-new-margin and fee-accrual rules as reduce-only placement. Futures replacements use the same directional limits as placement: buys at most 110% of the reference index; sells at least 90%; the passive side is not capped by this band. Failure leaves original order unchanged; same price is a no-op.
